events.title: Weather tracker: Extreme rain deluges Japan and South Korea
events.description: Downpours break records and cause transport chaos, evacuations and deaths, as people get trapped inside vehicles South Korea and Japan were hit by extreme rain late last week and into this week. On 13 August in the city of Chiba near Tokyo there was a record-breaking 115mm of rainfall in just one hour, while the nearby city of Sakura broke its own record with 97mm in one hour. Local authorities issued a level 5 emergency warning for heavy rain, the highest alert level and the first time one has been issued since the system was implemented in May. More than 100,000 households were asked to evacuate, with more than 20,000 in the Chiba prefecture left without power, while thousands of people were stranded at Tokyo’s Narita airport. Thirteen people have been confirmed dead, at least three of whom were found trapped inside their vehicles. One person is still missing. Continue reading...
events.ticker_label: ✈️ Weather tracker: Extreme rain deluges Japan and South Korea

events.title: Netanyahu focused on reelection as Israeli govt grows 'less concerned' about international isolation
events.description: Annette Young is pleased to welcome Dr. Aaron Y. Zelin, Senior Fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy. He sees Israel’s recent actions in the West Bank and Syria as part of a broader shift in its strategic posture. Since October 7, the Israeli government has become markedly less concerned with international opinion, prioritizing what it defines as its security interests even at the cost of growing diplomatic isolation. Domestic politics matter here. With elections approaching, some recent military activity can also be understood through an electoral lens. But he would distinguish that from Israel’s increasingly confrontational posture toward Turkey, which predates the current election cycle. As Iran and its regional proxy network have been weakened, figures around the Israeli prime minister have increasingly framed Turkey as a potential future strategic challenge.

events.description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada was "continuing its retaliation against the US," minutes before fresh Trump tariffs were due to come into effect. Canada says the terms proposed were "unfair."

events.title: German army helps Poland construct a defensive barrier against Russia
events.description: Poland is building a defense system along its northern and eastern borders to protect itself from Russia. Since June, German sappers have been assisting their NATO ally with the construction of the East Shield.

events.title: Swiss tourist jailed in Bali for insulting Hindu holiday
events.description: The 26-year-old was given a one-year prison sentence for offensive remarks posted on Instagram. During the trial, he apologized to the Balinese people for denigrating the Day of Silence and said he regretted his actions.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Swiss tourist jailed in Bali for insulting Hindu holiday

events.title: Germany investigates arms cache found in woods near Berlin
events.description: Handguns and ammunition were found in a forest near Berlin last year. German authorities suspect they were to be used for assassinations on behalf of Russian intelligence.

events.title: Ceuta: Spanish police arrest 5 alleged migrant traffickers
events.description: The arrests come after Spain's North African exclave saw a deadly border surge in late July, when tens of thousands of migrants entered Ceuta.

events.title: North Korea: Will Trump-Kim talks happen anytime soon?
events.description: As Donald Trump claims a meeting is planned with Kim Jong Un, North Korea's response sends a signal that it wants maximum concessions in return for talks with the US.

events.title: Who are the eight candidates running to succeed Antonio Guterres as UN chief?
events.description: The United Nations Security Council held a second informal straw poll to gauge the popularity of candidates seeking to succeed Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who will complete his second five-year term at the end of the year. Eight candidates are currently vying for the position against a backdrop of deep divisions within the organisation.

events.title: Brazillian football star Ronaldinho makes a comeback at the age of 46
events.description: Former Brazil football star Ronaldinho, who had retired in 2015, said on Thursday that he was making a comeback 11 years later with Italian third-division club Ravenna to try and score "a 300th goal".

events.title: PSG heavily favoured to win sixth successive Ligue 1 title
events.description: Paris Saint-Germain remains the team to beat in Ligue 1, with back-to-back Champions League triumphs bolstered by an influx of new arrivals this season. The team's opening match against Stade Rennais this Sunday has been moved to Rennes after their Parc de Prince pitch was deemed unsafe to play on after weeks of sweltering heat in Paris.

events.title: Body of Australian hiker recovered - day after officials said she had been found alive
events.description: The body of an 18-year-old hiker has been recovered from the Australian bush, a day after authorities incorrectly announced she had been found alive.

events.title: Ex-car salesman becomes Belgian prince as royal paternity confirmed
events.description: A former car salesman has become a prince after his father, Belgium's Prince Laurent, officially recognised him as his son.

events.title: Tanker boarded by six gunmen off Yemen
events.description: A tanker has been boarded by six gunmen off the coast of Yemen.

events.title: First group of deportees arrives in troubled Haiti after US ends TPS program
events.description: The U.S. has deported more than 160 people to Haiti for the first time since the Trump administration won a legal battle to end Temporary Protected Status for some 350,000 Haitians

events.title: US Treasury sanctions Ecuador-to-US cocaine trafficking network
events.description: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned 15 people involved in a network allegedly shipping cocaine from Ecuador through Mexico to the U.S. The operation uses Ecuador-based fishing vessels to transfer cocaine to power boats heading north

events.title: Pakistan may consider private hospital treatment for imprisoned ex-PM, minister says
events.description: A senior Pakistani Cabinet minister says the government could consider allowing imprisoned former Prime Minister Imran Khan to receive treatment at a private hospital or abroad if adequate medical care is unavailable at a government facility

events.title: Mobile gold miners in eastern Congo complicate health workers' efforts to contain Ebola
events.description: Eleven-year-old Isaac Batisa searches for gold at a mining site in eastern Congo to help feed his family

events.title: A historic boat emerges in Serbia as Europe's rivers run dry from drought and heat
events.description: The wreck of a steam tugboat from the early 1900s has emerged from shrinking waters in Serbia

events.title: Mpox: Children account for half of suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau
events.description: Children, who are particularly vulnerable to the disease, account for half of the 46 suspected mpox cases identified in Guinea-Bissau – with 16 of them under the age of four.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Mpox: Children account for half of suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau

events.title: The clean energy transition needs land. Can it help restore it too?
events.description: What if the infrastructure needed to fight climate change could also help repair the land beneath it?

events.title: Gaza: Only three per cent of cropland available to grow food
events.description: Amid ongoing deadly hostilities in Gaza, the enclave’s farmers face the increasingly difficult challenge of finding safe land to grow their crops.

events.title: Late-night bull run ends with a little cowboy know-how on busy California highway
events.description: A loose bull ran along Highway 35 for hours before Half Moon Bay ranch foreman Samuel Ramos Palomino answered the late-night call for help.

events.title: New Jersey mother allegedly drunk when boat hit channel marker on Memorial Day, killing her son
events.description: Jennifer L. Pearson allegedly had a blood alcohol level above the legal limit when her boat struck a channel marker in Barnegat Bay on Memorial Day.

events.title: WATCH: Deputies hunt wanted man through cornfield after high-speed chase caught on camera
events.description: Dash camera video captured a 12-mile Wisconsin police chase before the suspect bailed from a moving car and disappeared into a dense cornfield.

events.title: 12-year-old North Carolina girl escapes alleged kidnapper after being forced into truck
events.description: Daniel Gear allegedly forced a 12-year-old girl into his truck in Lillington, North Carolina, but she managed to escape at a DMV office in Erwin.

events.title: Karmelo Anthony new-trial fight reveals messages about knives, guns that murder jury never saw
events.description: Karmelo Anthony's new trial hearing centers on an unwritten agreement that kept him from testifying in the Austin Metcalf murder case in Frisco.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband has quietly remarried and started over amid her murder trial
events.description: Patrick Clancy testified about his children as Lindsay Clancy's defense argues postpartum psychosis.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Lindsay Clancy's ex-husband has quietly remarried and started over amid her murder trial

events.title: Surrogate says baby 'ripped away' 60 seconds after birth as custody fight erupts after abortion refusal
events.description: McKenna West says she was separated from the baby 60 seconds after birth and is now fighting for custody after the newborn's open-heart surgery procedure.

events.title: Christian Zionists take on anti-Israel ‘propaganda’ from biblical heartland
events.description: The Israel Guys inaugurated a major visitor center in Har Bracha on the West Bank, inviting Christians in Israel to see Judea and Samaria's biblical heartland firsthand.

events.title: UK Home Office guide tells asylum seekers not to rape, harass women or make kissing noises
events.description: Britain's Home Office published a guide reminding asylum seekers not to rape or sexually harass people, noting women can earn money and make decisions.

events.title: South Korean president jumps to invest in military after Trump cuts joint exercises
events.description: Lee Jae Myung urged stronger independent South Korean military capabilities after Trump ordered cuts to U.S.-South Korean Ulchi Freedom Shield drills.
